description: Search Mapbox documentation by keyword or natural language query. Searches across API reference, GL JS, Help Center, Style Spec, Studio, Search JS, iOS/Android Maps and Navigation SDKs, and Tilesets. Returns ranked results with titles, URLs, and descriptions. Use get_document_tool to fetch the full content of a result page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–20, default 5).

query.description: Search query for Mapbox documentation (e.g. "add a marker", "camera animation", "geocoding API").

name: search_mapbox_docs_tool
title: Search Mapbox Docs Tool
